title: Boxing Day Party Ideas: Food, Games and Guest Photos | Albums.ink
desc: Boxing Day party ideas for a relaxed UK get-together: leftover buffets, games, a winter walk – and one QR code that collects every guest’s photos.
h1: Boxing Day party ideas for a relaxed 26th December
lead: In the UK, Google suggests “boxing day party food”, “games” and “ideas for adults” as soon as you type “boxing day party”. Christmas Day is about the big dinner; Boxing Day is the bank holiday for friends, family you didn’t see on the 25th and plenty of leftovers. Here are ideas for a laid-back party and a simple way to gather everyone’s photos.
body: ## Food: make the most of the leftovers
- Cold cuts buffet: sliced turkey and gammon, pork pies, sausage rolls, a cheeseboard and chutneys.
- Bubble and squeak: fry up the leftover potatoes and sprouts – a Boxing Day classic.
- Turkey sandwiches or a turkey curry for a crowd later in the evening.
- Puddings: the rest of the Christmas pudding, trifle or mince pies with cream.
## Things to do
- Boxing Day walk: a short walk before lunch to blow away the cobwebs.
- Football: plan the food around the kick-off times if your guests follow the matches.
- Games: charades, a family quiz, or the board game someone unwrapped yesterday.
- Theme: Christmas jumpers again, or a cosy “pyjamas and leftovers” dress code.
## All the photos in one place
Everyone will take photos on their phones, and by New Year they are scattered across group chats. With an event album on Albums they all land in one place:
1. Create the album, e.g. “Boxing Day 2026 at ours”.
2. Put the QR code by the buffet or send it to the family WhatsApp group.
3. Guests scan it with their phone camera and upload photos and videos from the browser – nothing to install.
4. Turn on Hold guest photos to approve uploads before they appear.
5. Afterwards, download the whole album as one ZIP file.
Guests who upload without signing in appear anonymously. Signed-in guests also get a private draft copy with only their own uploads.

faq: What food do you serve at a Boxing Day party?
Usually leftovers: cold turkey and gammon, pork pies, bubble and squeak, cheese and Christmas pudding.
What can you do on Boxing Day?
A winter walk, watching the football, board games, a quiz or charades.
Do guests need to install anything?
No. They scan the QR code and upload from the browser.
How long are the photos kept?
6 months from the first upload, and the album can be extended.
